data.reason: The preceding canonical single-agent title/abstract decision is uncertain, requiring full-text assessment. The 2023 IEEE RO-MAN conference paper DOI 10.1109/ro-man57019.2023.10309631 (pp. 2045–2050) is identified in the Heriot-Watt institutional publication record, which supplies an abstract describing two video-based online studies, not original full Methods, audio/task utterances, or sample identity. As of 10 November 2026 the versioned Zenodo v1 supplement DOI 10.5281/zenodo.8042317 advertises ROMAN2023_Ila_Marta.pdf and an MD5 but the script PDF was not obtained or read: direct download timed out during this pass; a preview page rendered only viewer controls. Earlier R005 PR #111 documents unsuccessful legal original-file routes. A separate 2025 ACM article DOI 10.1145/3711938 describes a corn maze but does not demonstrate stimulus reuse, publication extension, or independent participant samples. Consequently no Track E E2 inclusion or exclusion, no experiment/sample identity, and no new count can be determined until the 2023 original report is accessible. This disposition is an access checkpoint, not a full-text reading or independent reviewer decision.
